title: Return Code Reductions on Credit Builder Accounts Returned-Payment Fees
content:
The returned-payment fee on a Credit Builder account is reduced for some return reasons. The return code is the one on the return line of the account's most recent returned payment.

## Reason shares

- When the return code is R09 (uncollected funds), the fee is multiplied by the uncollected-funds share of 0.75.
- When the return code is R02, R03 or R04 (account closed, account not found or invalid account number), the fee is multiplied by the account-problem share of 0.9.
- When the return code is any other fee-bearing code, the fee is not reduced for the return reason.

The share multiplies the fee before it is rounded to the cent.

| Return code | Share |
|---|---|
| R09 | 0.75 |
| R02, R03, R04 | 0.9 |
| R01, R08, R16, R20 | no reduction |
